# Workflow maintenance

## Release tool

`workflows/release.yml` pins the GoReleaser Linux x86-64 release archive by
version and SHA-256. The installer supports Linux/X64 runners only, downloads
over HTTPS with bounded timeouts, and verifies the committed digest before
extracting the executable into a fresh runner-temporary directory. It publishes
that directory to PATH only after installation succeeds. Release and Homebrew
credentials belong to the separate `goreleaser release --clean` step.

GoReleaser 2.18.2 is the version used by the
[successful CLI release run](https://github.com/agilercloud/cli/actions/runs/37566953156).
Its `goreleaser_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz` SHA-256 is
`0a96edc9d9bc594e4a41cc4d59467c182062910ab24d9d1f6dd7b667d32606d3`.
The independently hashed archive matched both the
[upstream checksum file](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/releases/download/v2.18.2/checksums.txt)
and the GitHub release asset API digest. Its provenance attestation verified
against the release workflow identity, GitHub Actions OIDC issuer, and source
commit `25a52e520f9c993711b93ea1111ed90c024e0528`:

```sh
gh attestation verify goreleaser_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz \
  --repo goreleaser/goreleaser \
  --cert-identity https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v2.18.2 \
  --cert-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --source-digest 25a52e520f9c993711b93ea1111ed90c024e0528
```

The attested producer is
[upstream run 35176857515](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/actions/runs/35176857515/attempts/1).
CI checks the committed digest; it does not depend on online attestation
availability or install a signature verifier on every release. This pins
reviewed bytes, not proof that upstream code is free of defects.

### Updating the pin

Repository maintainers own manual review of GoReleaser releases during weekly
dependency review and promptly on security advisories. Dependabot updates
Actions, not this binary pin. Choose an explicit compatible release, download its
archive and checksums without executing it, independently calculate SHA-256,
compare the checksum and GitHub asset digest, and verify its attestation against
the expected tagged workflow and source commit as above. Review upstream changes,
then update the version, digest, and provenance documentation together in a PR.
Run installer tests and normal CI before merging.

Pins do not expire. Missing maintenance retains an older version and its possible
vulnerabilities. Missing downloads or changed bytes stop the release; monitor
failed CI/release notifications and upstream advisories during dependency review.
Investigate failures and prepare a reviewed replacement pin; never bypass
verification. There is no additional service or recurring infrastructure cost,
only maintainer review and existing Actions runner minutes.

## Local installer checks

```sh
python3 .github/test_release_installer.py
```

Tests use Python's standard library, Bash, tar, and `sha256sum`. They execute the
workflow's installer against local fixture archives, exercising successful
installation and fail-closed behavior without downloading or executing upstream
binaries. CI runs these checks on pull requests and main pushes.

## Action lockfile

`workflows/actions.lock` is generated by the official
`github/gh-actions-lock` CLI extension, pinned to v0.4.1. After changing action
dependencies, regenerate with `gh actions-lock`, review the diff, then run
`gh actions-lock --verify-local` and `gh actions-lock --verify`. Never edit the
lockfile manually. Installing the extension on an agent's workstation requires
separate approval. Lock generation and verification do not replace archive
digest verification.
